description: Morning Anxiety Relief | Bansuri Raga Bilawal | 1.5 Hours of gentle bamboo flute to quiet a racing morning mind.
When you wake up already worrying — start here instead. Ninety minutes of soft bansuri in Raga Bilawal, the clear morning raga, to ease the tension before the day begins.
🎧 HOW TO USE — play softly as you wake, breathe, get ready. Gentle and unhurried.
⏱ BEST FOR — morning anxiety · waking up worried · a calm unrushed start · gentle mornings
🎵 ABOUT — Raga Bilawal is the bright, open morning raga of Indian classical music; the bansuri its gentlest voice.
